name: civicpulse
description: CivicPulse — AI complaint triage for Chennai civic bodies

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.typecheck: npm --prefix server run typecheck && npm --prefix client run typecheck
scripts.dev:demo: concurrently -k -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm --prefix server run dev:memory" "npm --prefix client run dev"
